senses.gloss: सु-महा- + अत्यय सु-महा- + अत्यय, adj. very dangerous, Chr. 37, 3.
सु-महा- + तपस् सु-महा- + तपस्, adj. one who has practised very great religious austerities, Chr. 11, 23.
सु-महा- + बल सु-महा- + बल, adj. very strong, Chr. 54, 14.
सु-मन्द- + बुद्धि सु-मन्द- + बुद्धि, adj. very disheartened, Chr. 41, 8.
सु- + मख सु- + मख, adj. probably well fighting, a powerful warrior, Chr. 291, 5 = Rigv. i. 85, 5. []
सु- + मङ्गल सु- + मङ्गल, adj. very fortunate or auspicious.

सु- + मति सु- + मति,
 I. f. kindness.
 II. adj. very wise, Pañc. 25, 13.
सु- + मद सु- + मद, adj. very drunk, mad, or impassioned.
सु- + मध्यम सु- + मध्यम, adj. having a fine waist, Rām. 3, 52, 49.

सु- + मत सु- + मत, adj. kindly disposed. Desider.
 I. † मिमनिष and † मिमंस.
 II. Anomal. मीमांस, Ātm. []
 1. To consider, Man. 4, 224.
 2. To learn, MBh. 1, 3878.

सु- + मनस् सु- + मनस्,
 I. adj. satisfied, Lass. 54, 20.
 II. m. 1. a god. 2. a learned man. 3. a student of the Vedas. 4. wheat. 5. the name of two plants.
 II. m. n. and f. (the last only pl.), a flower, Man. 2, 182.
 III. f. सी, great flowered jasmine.
सु- + मनोहर सु- + मनोहर, adj. very charming, Pañc. pr. d. 3.

सु- + मन्त्रित सु- + मन्त्रित,
 I. adj. 1. well deliberated, Hit. iii. d. 137. 2. well counselled.
 II. n. wise counsel.
सु- + मन्त्रज्ञ सु- + मन्त्रज्ञ, adj. well versed in holy texts, Johns. Sel. 10, 20.
सु- + महन्त् सु- + महन्त्, adj. 1. very great, Chr. 12, 26; very tall, Rām. 3, 55, 1. 2. very important, Nal. 8, 2. 3. abundant.
सु- + माय सु- + माय, adj. abounding in tricks (?), Chr. 293, 1 = Rigv. i. 88, 1.
सु- + मार्दव सु- + मार्दव, n. beautiful softness, Pañc. iv. d. 62.
सु- + मित्त्र सु- + मित्त्र, f. त्रा, one of the wives of Daśaratha.

सु- + मुख सु- + मुख,
 I. n. a beautiful mouth, Pañc. i. d. 202.
 II. adj., f. खा and खी. 1. handsome-faced. 2. pleasing, propitious, Lass. 55, 20.
 III. [] m. 1. a teacher. 2. a proper name, Man. 7, 41.
 IV. n. the scratch of a finger-nail.
सु-मृष्ट सु-मृष्ट, adj. very fine, Pañc. 113, 8; very delicate, i. d. 303.

सु- + मेरु सु- + मेरु,
 I. m. = Meru.
 II. adj. excellent.

शुम्भ् शुम्भ् (cf. 2. शुभ्), i. 6, Par. (ved. also Ātm.) To shine.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, Ātm. To assume as ornament, to adorn one's self with (acc.), Chr. 295, 10 = Rigv. i. 92, 10.
 --With प्र प्र, Ātm. To adorn one's self carefully, Chr. 291, 1 = Rigv. i. 85, 1.
 --Cf. probably, A.S. camb: O.H.G. kamp; κομψός.
सुम्भ् सुम्भ्, see 2. शुभ्.
सुम सुम, probably 1. सु + म (cf. [] सून, प्रसून, s. v. 1. सु), n. A flower, Cāṇ. 24 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 408.

सूम सू + म (see vb. 1. सु), m.
 1. Milk.
 2. Water.
 3. Sky.
सुमर सुमर, i. e. सु-मृ + अ, adj. Easy to die, Rām. 2, 57, 20 Gorr.

सुम्न 4. सु + म्न, n. A hymn.
 --Cf. ὕμνος.
सुम्नयु सुम्नयु, i. e. सुम्न + य, a ved. denomin., + उ, m. A chanter of hymns.
